hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: When arbitrary numbers can be modified or added to satisfy reachable range [1, target], evaluate the current coverage limit.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort the input numbers and track the maximum consecutive prefix sum reachable so far.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: If the next available number exceeds reachable plus one, insert reachable plus one and increment the count of added elements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minPatches(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    miss = 1
    added = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(nums)
    while miss <= target:
        if i < n and nums[i] <= miss:
            miss += nums[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            miss += miss
            added += 1
    return added
```

complexity.notes: Patched range expansion greedily doubles reach whenever gaps occur.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive subset generation is intractable for large target values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates directly in-place with minimal tracking variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes doubling property of the greedy patching strategy.
